objective: Implement the approved cross-repository engineering scope hook using TDD
acceptance_criteria: SC01-SC03: distinguish inspection, approved actions, and scope amendments
SC04-SC07: protect paths, approval revisions, existing edits, and sensitive operations
SC08-SC10: use supported hook responses with meaningful automated coverage
exclusions: Application code, Category behavior, database, dependencies, infrastructure, and historical handover
Broader harness implementation, commit, push, and deployment
AI self-approval or automatic trust of the installed hooks

tdd.red: Write checker and subprocess-adapter tests first, run unittest, and observe the missing checker failure; add failing regression cases before fixes
tdd.green: Implement the shared checker, human approval CLI, hook adapter, and registration until the same suite passes
tdd.refactor: Consolidate path, revision, and command checks; rerun the full checker suite and review scope and documentation
